abstract: Retraction: "Long noncoding RNA MEG3 is a tumor suppressor in choriocarcinoma by upregulation of microRNA-211," by Li Ji, Xue Li, J Cell Physiol. 2019; 22911-22920: The above article, published online on 23 May 2019 in Wiley Online Library (https://onlinelibrary.wiley.com/doi/full/10.1002/jcp.28853), has been retracted by agreement between the journal's Editor in Chief, Prof. Dr. Gregg Fields, and Wiley Periodicals LLC. The retraction has been agreed following an investigation based on allegations raised by a third party. Several flaws and inconsistencies between results presented and experimental methods described were found, the editors consider the conclusions of this article to be invalid. The authors collaborated in the investigation initially, but were not available for a final confirmation of the retraction.
abstract_ja: 撤回通知：Li Ji、Xue Li著「Long noncoding RNA MEG3 is a tumor suppressor in choriocarcinoma by upregulation of microRNA-211」(J Cell Physiol. 2019; 22911-22920)の撤回。当該論文は2019年5月23日にWiley Online Libraryで公開されたが、第三者からの申し立てに基づく調査の結果、編集者との合意により撤回された。結果と記載された実験方法の間に複数の欠陥と不整合が見つかり、編集者は本論文の結論が無効であると判断した。著者らは当初調査に協力したが、撤回の最終確認には応じなかった。
